question: What is a model's context window?

options.text: How fast it can type a reply
How much text it can consider at once
How large its screen display is

teachLine: The context window is the amount of text the model can hold in view while answering — your prompt plus its reply. Beyond that limit, earlier words fall out of sight.
callbackFact: A context window is the maximum amount of text (tokens) a model can attend to at one time when generating a response.
